definition: A hindrance of agitation, unsettledness, and regretful mental churn.
notes: The project uses restlessness and worry as the default for this hindrance because that is how Dhammarato names it throughout the 2014–2026 talk transcripts (restlessness and worry about three times as often as restlessness and remorse, against no uses of agitated distraction); restlessness matches uddhacca, and worry is kukkucca's recorded alternate; restlessness and remorse stays as the alternate that follows the members' own defaults. It names churned-up instability that prevents inner settling. Agitated distraction, the earlier house default built on the OSF glossary's distraction family, remains the alternate where continuity with earlier OSF material matters. The family label is now hindrance (nīvaraṇa), and the five members are named the way Dhammarato names them. Compounds built on this pair inherit the same name unless a narrower compound record documents an override.
